script_text: Aries, this week Saturn in your 1st House collides with Neptune’s fog—don’t mistake pressure for failure. Early Monday to Wednesday, Mars, your ruler, in your 9th House sextiles Pluto in your 11th, moving career and money forward; Tuesday is strongest, while Wednesday’s Moon square Saturn tests patience. Midweek, Venus in your 8th House sextiles Mercury in your 9th, turning attraction into honest talk—if you’ve awaited a partner’s answer, it clarifies. Thursday through Sunday, Jupiter in your 5th House trines your Fire sign, sparking romance and creative risk; the weekend favors a date that feels like an adventure, but don’t overspend. Wednesday is your power day because Mercury in Sagittarius in your 9th House, sextile Saturn, opening a career door. Tuesday is your worst day because the Moon squares Saturn in your 1st House. Tip: say the thing you’ve rehearsed, then listen. Follow for daily updates.
